pages.quiz:
ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #12
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x + 2

2. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x ≥ 0 only
   B. x < 5
   C. x = 5
   D. x > 5

3. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 8
   C. 9
   D. 64

4. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 49
   D. 2

5. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. Cannot tell

6. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 9
   C. 81
   D. 18

7. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 90

8. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 43
   C. 1
   D. 1

9. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 31

10. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 121
   C. 122
   D. 22

11. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 28
   C. 22
   D. 33

12. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

13. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 30
   C. 18
   D. 45

14. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 19.6
   C. 19
   D. 25

15. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 13
   C. 41
   D. 3

16. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31
   C. 31.7
   D. 31.6

17. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 2
   C. 12
   D. 10

18. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

19. Solve for x: x + 5 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 15
   C. 10
   D. 11

20. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 25

21. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

22. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

23. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 48
   C. 24
   D. 156

24. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 73
   B. 17
   C. 1
   D. 72

25. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 170
   C. 26
   D. 169

26. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 36

27. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 56
   B. 15
   C. 57
   D. 1

28. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 32
   C. 4
   D. 33

29. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27
   C. 27.7
   D. 33

30. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 50
   C. 14
   D. 7
